kurz: Strong acid changes protein much like heat does: raw fish in lime juice turns firm and opaque.
was_passiert: [[saeure|Acid]] unfolds the protein chains; they link up anew and turn firm and white. Unlike heat, though, acid does not kill all germs, which is why ceviche needs very fresh fish.
warum_wichtig: Explains ceviche, and why acid marinades left too long make meat and fish mealy.
faustregeln: Make ceviche only with very fresh fish.
Do not marinate fish in acid for hours, otherwise it turns mealy.
